hero.headline: Identify Any Adhesive in Seconds
hero.subheadline: DREAMS Atlas combines infrared and Raman spectroscopy with machine learning to classify adhesives instantly — no sample prep, no wet chemistry, no waiting.

problem.headline: Adhesive Testing Is Broken
problem.body: Traditional adhesive identification relies on slow, expensive wet-lab methods. A single test can take hours to days, cost $50-200+, and requires specialized chemists and hazardous reagents. In a $65B+ global adhesive market, there is no scalable, automated classification solution.

pain_points.label: Global adhesive market with no automated QC

technology.headline: AI-Powered Spectral Classification
technology.body: DREAMS Atlas uses dual-modality spectroscopy — combining infrared (IR/FTIR) and Raman signals — with purpose-built machine learning models to classify adhesives into seven major families. Our models are trained on a proprietary dataset of 1,500+ curated adhesive spectra and validated using compound-grouped cross-validation to ensure real-world generalization.

how_it_works.title: Scan
how_it_works.description: Place your sample under a standard benchtop or portable IR/Raman spectrometer. No preparation needed.

how_it_works.title: Classify
how_it_works.description: DREAMS Atlas processes the spectral signature through our trained RandomForest and CNN-1D ensemble models.

how_it_works.title: Result
how_it_works.description: Get an instant classification across 7 adhesive families with confidence scores and spectral feature attribution.

differentiators.title: Compound-Grouped Validation
differentiators.description: 5-fold cross-validation grouped by chemical compound eliminates data leakage and ensures the model generalizes to unseen formulations.

differentiators.title: Domain-Validated Features
differentiators.description: Spectral features align with known adhesive chemistry — epoxide ring breathing at 910-915 cm⁻¹, urethane N-H at 3300 cm⁻¹, silicone Si-O-Si at 1000-1100 cm⁻¹.

differentiators.title: Dual-Modality Fusion
differentiators.description: Combining IR and Raman spectroscopy captures complementary molecular information for more robust classification.

differentiators.title: Proprietary Dataset
differentiators.description: 1,500+ labeled adhesive spectra across 43 unique compounds — over $1.2M to replicate.
